# SelfHacked

> SelfHacked is a science-based health resource exploring the genetics, biochemistry, and physiology of human health through detailed guides on neurotransmitters, hormones, mitochondrial function, and personalized genetic insights.

SelfHacked provides evidence-based educational content on how genes, neurotransmitters, and metabolic processes influence health outcomes. The site combines genetic analysis, biochemical mechanisms, and health science to help readers understand their biology and optimize wellness through personalized approaches.

## Key Topics

- Dopamine
- Mitochondria
- Neurotransmitters
- Genetic variants
- Hormones
- Oxytocin
- Brain health
- Circadian rhythm
- Uric acid metabolism
- Oxidative stress
- SNP analysis
- Sleep physiology
- Stress response
- Personalized health
- Reward system

## Neurotransmitters & Brain Chemistry

- [What Does Dopamine Do? 18 Surprising Health Effects](https://selfhacked.com/blog/dopamine): Comprehensive guide to dopamine's roles in pleasure, motivation, and brain chemistry.
- [What is Motivation? Definition, Theories & Link to Dopamine](https://selfhacked.com/blog/motivation-definition-theories): Examines motivation theories, dopamine pathways, and behavioral science connections.
- [8 Important Roles of Glutamate + Is It Bad in Excess?](https://selfhacked.com/blog/glutamate): Analyzes glutamate's neurotransmitter functions and risks of excess exposure.
- [The Vagus Nerve, Neurotransmitters & Hormones](https://selfhacked.com/blog/the-vagus-nerve-neurotransmitters-hormones): Explains vagus nerve interactions with serotonin, oxytocin, and other neurotransmitters.
- [Adenosine: Sleep, Receptors, Effects + 3 Ways to Increase](https://selfhacked.com/blog/adenosine-health-effects): Covers adenosine's roles in sleep regulation and circadian rhythm control.

## Hormones & Endocrine Function

- [What is Progesterone? Definition & Function](https://selfhacked.com/blog/progesterone-function): Educational overview of progesterone hormone functions in reproduction and brain health.
- [Oxytocin Genes (OXTR) & SNPs: Are You High or Low in it?](https://selfhacked.com/blog/oxytocin-genes-snps): Analyzes OXTR gene SNPs affecting oxytocin levels and social bonding capacity.
- [CYP21A2 Enzyme, Fertility, & Stress](https://selfhacked.com/blog/cyp21a2): Analyzes CYP21A2 enzyme's role in steroid hormone regulation and fertility.
- [What is GLP-1 & Does it Affect Weight & Cognition?](https://selfhacked.com/blog/glp-1-a-hormone-that-causes-weight-loss-and-good-cognitive-effects): Examines GLP-1 hormone's effects on weight loss, cognition, and blood sugar control.
- [Hypothalamus 101](https://selfhacked.com/blog/hypothalamus-101): Educational guide to hypothalamus anatomy, hormone regulation, and brain functions.

## Sleep, Circadian Rhythm & Immune Function

- [The VLPO and Ascending Arousal System in Sleep](https://selfhacked.com/blog/the-vlpo-and-ascending-arousal-system-in-sleep): Explains VLPO and ascending arousal system mechanisms in sleep physiology.
- [Melatonin in Inflammation, Autoimmune Diseases & Immunity](https://selfhacked.com/blog/melatonin-th1-th2-inflammation-autoimmune-diseases): Explores melatonin's complex roles in immune function and autoimmune disease management.

## Mitochondrial & Cellular Health

- [What Are Mitochondria? Definition, Function & Structure](https://selfhacked.com/blog/mitochondria): Foundational guide to mitochondria structure, ATP synthesis, and energy production.
- [Mitochondrial Diseases & Mitochondrial Dysfunction](https://selfhacked.com/blog/mitochondrial-dysfunction-disease): Discusses mitochondrial dysfunction, diseases, and oxidative stress effects on cells.

## Genetics & Personalized Health

- [Genes that May Affect Uric Acid Levels](https://selfhacked.com/blog/genes-uric-acid): Explores genetic variants in SLC2A9 and other genes affecting uric acid levels and gout risk.
- [Genetics of Erythropoiesis (Red Blood Cell Creation)](https://selfhacked.com/blog/genetics-of-erythropoiesis-red-blood-cell-creation): Covers genetic factors in red blood cell creation including JAK2 and GATA1 genes.
- [Constitutive Androstane Receptor (CAR) Benefits & Reactions](https://selfhacked.com/blog/constitutive-androstane-receptor): Details CAR receptor's role in drug metabolism and supplement tolerance.

## Optional

- [Uric Acid, IQ, Productivity & Lifespan: Is There a Link?](https://selfhacked.com/blog/uric-acid-iq-productivity-lifespan): Explores correlations between uric acid levels and cognitive and longevity outcomes.
